scope: Dedicated loopback; fresh owned fictional private forms/accounts/answers only. Exact before/after-loss draft/submission/edit and simultaneous draft saves. No providers/mail workers or real chapter/production changes. Owned forms archived/edit capabilities revoked/drafts expired/accounts disabled/sessions revoked; fictional response/audit rows retained privately, no physical-erasure claim. No raw token/key/body/answer/email/capability retained in report.
